articles.title: Then & Now: Linden Road in 1985 and Today
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1985 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Linden Road from the corner of Franklin Avenue.
Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal.

articles.title: Letter: St. Brendan’s Parish Did a Good Job This Winter
body: To the editor: Please keep the sidewalk ramp in the budget. Many of us on Glen Terrace use it every week. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

To the editor: I have lived on Glen Terrace for 19 years, and I want to say what a difference St. Brendan’s Parish has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the September meeting.
Dana Sokolov, Eastgate
